**Files in `output/`:**
- `main.py` (261 lines) — CLI entry point and argument handling
- `rs_parser.py` (425 lines) — RS274/NGC tokenizer and recursive-descent parser, including parameter values, expressions with operator precedence, unary functions
- `rs_state.py` (108 lines) — Machine state container with modal groups, positions, and offsets
- `rs_trace.py` (278 lines) — Delta-encoded trace collector with stepping modes
- `rs_interp.py` (1832 lines) — Main interpreter: state transitions, motion (linear/arc/canned cycles), G28/G30/G53/G10/G92, probing, cutter radius compensation
- `rs_io.py` (175 lines) — File I/O for tool tables, parameter files, JSON output

**Features implemented:**
- Full RS274/NGC parsing (block-delete, line numbers, expressions, parameters, comments, % demarcation)
- All modal groups (G & M) with correct serialization
- G0/G1 linear motion, G2/G3 arcs (radius and center format), helical arcs, G18/G19 plane handling
- G81-G89 canned cycles with sticky parameters, including G84 (tapping with spindle flips) and G87 (back boring)
- G28/G30 home returns, G53 absolute, G92/G92.1/G92.2/G92.3 origin offsets, G10 coord system setup
- Tool changes (M6), tool length offset (G43/G49), cutter radius compensation (G40/G41/G42, basic)
- G38.2 probing with --probe-box trip detection
- Trace stepping in all three modes (time/distance/tolerance)
- Time computation honoring G93 inverse time and G94 units/min
- Parameter file read/write per RS274 §3.2.1
- M2/M30 program-end reset with correct serialized modal codes
